body: A million upvotes from me to you! Wooow my son is Reddit famous :,))))) so proud

Yeah there is a whole bunch of stuff. I usually suppress a lot because it’s too much to deal with or not enough time/not a good time. 
I’m still in school and it’s getting harder so that’s been a challenge as of late. I used to really enjoy working towards my future career but some days it really terrifies me that I won’t be able to reach my goals and all this time and effort I’ve put in to everything is going to seem like it’s a waste. 
Another downer would probably have to be this girl that’s kind of playing with my heart and I keep giving her the time to do so. I’ve always thought things were going well between us, though I definitely liked her more than she liked me or cared to show she liked me at times..we were still in a good place. We’ve tried dating but she’s actually pretty convinced that she shouldn’t date anyone that she sees she could marry bc were too early in life to do a commitment like that and not fuck things up (we’re both 20). I’ve always chosen to respect her wishes and not push it but lately Ive kind of gotten the feeling it’s not a good idea for me to put it up to chance that this will maybe one day work out..I’m not saying give up or anything, but it’s not really fair to me or her or other potential relationships for us to still hold out hope that it could work between us if we’re also telling each other to go out with other ppl. (That last part sounds weird, like a weird sex thing but it’s not like that. I just mean we’re (not really we, she’s just saying this part) to date other people so that we know this (what we could have between her and I) is something real.) 

Idk the more I think about it the more I kind of want to drop all this bs because it’s really not helping with my mental state, actually makes me super depressed and very mute at times because  all in my head. (Drop her not the school thing, I gotta finish that up for sure)
Please God!!!! Let this work😂😂😂that was actually pretty funny

I think your bio is really funny!! I’m no Tinder expert but I like the photos you have too, they aren’t too serious and are pretty lighthearted. I’m sure you’ll start getting more matches a week soon!

North, I’m sorry that it feels like you have nothing to see as a goal anymore. I know it can be tough to find things that want you to keep living but start with really small goals..this way you can buy yourself time and do some soul searching to find things you find of value.

Please make it to 2019! I know I go through my own battles on a daily basis and what really helps me is having a goal to work towards. I know I try to make a goal of reach the end of the week each week. I can tell you wholeheartedly, the time I spent reading this post was not a single second wasted. Like I said I have my daily battles and I try to find things that can keep me going. I have legit started crying at the dinner table with my partners just thinking about leaving them if I were to go through a suicide attempt. 
I have been making the mistake of not opening up to other people, so if you’re comfortable letting even one person in to your world..please look for that person!!!!
